# Generated by tools/generate_global_ig_compat.py. IG scope unless stated otherwise.

ffpa_global_ig_remove_paternalistic = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_paternalistic }
		remove_ideology = ideology_paternalistic
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ffpa_global_ig_property_conservatism }
		remove_ideology = ideology_ffpa_global_ig_property_conservatism
	}
}

ffpa_global_ig_add_paternalistic = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_interest_group_type = ig_landowners }
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_paternalistic }
			remove_ideology = ideology_paternalistic
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ffpa_provincial_compact
				}
			}
			ffpa_global_ig_remove_paternalistic = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ffpa_global_ig_property_conservatism } }
			add_ideology = ideology_ffpa_global_ig_property_conservatism
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_ideology = ideology_paternalistic
	}
}

ffpa_global_ig_remove_laissez_faire = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire }
		remove_ideology = ideology_laissez_faire
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ffpa_global_ig_developmentalism }
		remove_ideology = ideology_ffpa_global_ig_developmentalism
	}
}

ffpa_global_ig_add_laissez_faire = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_interest_group_type = ig_industrialists }
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire }
			remove_ideology = ideology_laissez_faire
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ffpa_tur_state_developmentalism
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ffpa_mediterranean_developmentalism
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoliberism
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ffpa_usa_continental_market
				}
			}
			ffpa_global_ig_remove_laissez_faire = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ffpa_global_ig_developmentalism } }
			add_ideology = ideology_ffpa_global_ig_developmentalism
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_ideology = ideology_laissez_faire
	}
}

# Country scope. Eight bounded mappings; no population/state/building traversal.
ffpa_global_ig_ensure_positions_v1 = {
	ig:ig_landowners ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_paternalistic }
			ffpa_global_ig_add_paternalistic = yes
		}
	}
	ig:ig_landowners ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_hierarchic }
			ffpa_global_ig_add_hierarchic = yes
		}
	}
	ig:ig_industrialists ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_laissez_faire }
			ffpa_global_ig_add_laissez_faire = yes
		}
	}
	ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reactionary }
			ffpa_global_ig_add_reactionary = yes
		}
	}
	ig:ig_petty_bourgeoisie ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_patriotic }
			ffpa_global_ig_add_patriotic = yes
		}
	}
	ig:ig_rural_folk ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_isolationist }
			ffpa_global_ig_add_isolationist = yes
		}
	}
	ig:ig_devout ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_moralist }
			ffpa_global_ig_add_moralist = yes
		}
	}
	ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_proletarian }
			ffpa_global_ig_add_proletarian = yes
		}
	}
}
